text:
release-coordinator: FYI team — initiating a temporary hold on the APAC v3.5 canary expansion. We're seeing a rise in OOM/retry spikes on dedicated pools when batch sizes exceed usual medians. Putting a short freeze (target ~30-60m) while runtime/infra validate a kernel selector fix and we run targeted canary smoke.
oncall-bot: NOTICE: Elevated 429/500 rates detected on dedicated-gpu-pool-5 during canary ramp. Alert routed to oncall.
casey: Observed memory fragmentation patterns after grpc keepalive bursts. Heap growth aligns with larger batches (~>5k tokens across requests).
nina: Can we reduce max-batch or enforce per-connection limits as a mitigation? I can push routing rule to cap batch_size to 256 for canary traffic.
leo: I've applied temporary throttle: canary -> 0.5r/s and max_batch=256 for apac region. Commands run:
```
redwood routing update --canary apac-v3-5 --throttle 0.5
redwood runtime set-param --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-5 --max-batch 256
```
toni: Thanks Leo. QA: please run the reduced-batch regression set `prompts/regression/longseq_minimal.json`. I'll validate correctness and perf.
casey: Logs show `ALLOC_FAIL` originating from fused-attn kernel path on some CUDA variants. Suspect kernel selector picks a faster but less memory-frag-resilient kernel for seq>1024.
nina: Filing REG-503 with stack dumps and annotated perf traces, tagging eng-runtime and infra.
leo: CI build `hotfix/kernel-fallback-2026-03-23` pushed to staging; runtime unit tests include synthetic long-seq patterns.
release-coordinator: Proposed plan: 1) maintain hold and throttles (done), 2) validate staging hotfix + run smoke with reduced batch set (30m), 3) if green, resume canary at conservative throttle (0.5r/s) and monitor 15m windows; 4) schedule broader rollout with kernel selector opt-in and a post-rollout perf watch for 48h. ETA for first validation: ~45m. If we hit regressions, we'll rollback to v3.4 across APAC.
oncall-bot: Pager: casey, leo. Notifying backup oncall.
casey: I'll stream heap/alloc profiles and post link to infra traces.
toni: QA started staging smoke now. Will post pass/fail in 20m.
leo: If anyone needs to ship docs-only or cherrypicks that don't touch runtime, DM me for freeze-exception.
release-coordinator: Reminder: hold all non-essential merges to release branches until we clear this canary. Exceptions only for hotfixes that are validated in staging.
casey: +1, will monitor and update every 15 minutes.
leo: +20m update: staging smoke running; no OOMs observed so far on reduced batch config. Collecting perf metrics.
release-coordinator: Great — once QA gives a full pass we'll do a controlled resume with watchful gates. Posting final go/no-go here when ready.
